title: Quietly Dense Moroccan Grain Tagine
description: A hearty, herbal Moroccan dish featuring mixed grain and a sweet glaze, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This low-sodium-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: mixed grains
ingredients.notes: such as bulgur, quinoa, and brown rice

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the mixed grains, olive oil, onion, garlic, and ginger until well combined.
In a small bowl, mix together the cumin, coriander, and honey until well combined.
Add the cumin mixture to the grain mixture and stir until the grains are evenly coated.
In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, bring the chicken broth to a boil.
Add the grain mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, then stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the grains are tender.
